title: Lum's Resource Pack
description: The Resource Pack used for Lumineth, adds textures to items, foods, mobs and more!
body:
# Lum's Resource Pack
Lum is a **Required** Resource Pack for [Lumineth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/lumineth), that adds customs textures to items, weapons, biome altered mobs, and more.

![Example dof Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d51a69d42062eae1fb662299cfa0eff31ce37307.png)

### Textures for Mobs
- In order to see mob textures you need the mod [[ETF] Entity Texture Feature](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) - opcional
